audit.whatIsWrong: The whole early-lane story rests on 'Ziggs' Bouncing Bomb range outclasses your Q'. Bouncing Bomb is 850. Aurora's Q is 900. She out-ranges his poke button.
audit.why: 49.05% over 787 games at 5.5/10. His level 1-2 edge is real but it is cast frequency, not distance: Bouncing Bomb is 6s at rank 1 (down to 4s) and Short Fuse's bonus-damage attack refreshes faster every time he casts anything, so he chips continuously while your Q is on 9s. Telling a player they are out-ranged makes them stand further back than they need to and gives up the one advantage they have.
audit.corrected: early, whys[0], whys[1], spikes[0].text and phases[0..1].why now state 850 vs 900 and locate his edge in Short Fuse plus his cooldown.

audit.why: Spike order holds: he owns levels 1-2, the full Aurora pattern takes over from 3, and neither ultimate decides the duel — Mega Inferno Bomb is a 5000-range wave and objective tool at 120/95/70. That last point was already stated correctly in spikes[1].text and is unusually good.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields (spikes[0].text, spikes[3].text, mid, wants.you[1]) call Aurora's E a gap-close — 'E Weirding gives you the mobility to close his range advantage', 'E's dash-adjacent mobility'. Riot's text for her E is a blast that damages and slows before Aurora HOPS BACKWARD to safety. It moves her away, not toward.
audit.why: This inverts the actual instruction against an immobile enemy. The closing tools are W (700 hop) and the R teleport; E is the slow that holds him still once you are there. A player following the old text walks at Ziggs pressing a disengage.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten: W closes, E slows. Also added the real Satchel Charge behaviour — it knocks Ziggs away as well as you, so it is escape and reposition in one, on 20/18/16/14/12.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit, and the packet reports only one sequencing cue in the whole matchup.
audit.why: Defect item 3. Satchel Charge 20s at rank 1, Bouncing Bomb 6s to 4s, Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s at every rank, Mega Inferno Bomb 120/95/70.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with all three lane numbers; the flat-16s minefield is now the concrete 'when not to step in' timer.

audit.why: Packet and content agree; the sides were stale and the first two whys argued with the verdict.
audit.corrected: All seven sides aligned as one group, phases[0..1].rating dropped to 4/10, and phases[0..1].why rewritten to Ziggs verdicts grounded in Short Fuse and the 6s bomb.

edits.after: A fed Ziggs zones the whole lane: mines at 900, bombs on a 4s cooldown, and a satchel to leave with. Behind, farm from max range, never stand on the minefield, and let your jungler take the flank angle.

edits.before: Carry through tempo — patterns that exit free compound; your zone turns objective fights into speed checks they fail.
edits.after: Carry by making him spend Satchel Charge: it is his only escape on 20s, and an immobile Ziggs without it is a free kill.

edits.before: You warp the fight: R the clump, hop through the middle, and pattern whoever the zone slows. The exit portal is your insurance.
edits.after: Late, Mega Inferno Bomb lands from 5000 on the objective — spread for it, then hop the flank: Ziggs holds no ground once you arrive.

edits.after: Ahead, take his range away: shove so he clears with Bouncing Bomb, punish each 20s Satchel Charge, and fight where he cannot satchel to safety.

edits.before: Hopping IN with W and trading while his engage is still loaded — the exit spent as an entrance is how Auroras get coached postmortem.
edits.after: With your E down you have no slow, and Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s — standing in his rotation is free chip for him.

edits.before: Ziggs' longer Bouncing Bomb range lets him poke Aurora for free before she has E's gap-close online.
edits.after: Short Fuse and a 6-second Bouncing Bomb let Ziggs chip Aurora for free while she last-hits.

edits.before: Same range disadvantage persists — Aurora still lacks the tools to punish his poke safely.

edits.before: Ziggs' Bouncing Bomb outranges Q Twin Drift at levels 1-2, but once you have E Weirding available to close distance and punish his cooldowns, you start winning the trade window he can't escape.
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb is 850 to your 900, so the range was never his edge — once your full pattern is online, the W hop closes and the E slow holds him inside it while Satchel Charge is on its 20s.

edits.before: By 2+ items you fully close the range gap with E's dash-adjacent mobility, and Ziggs' immobility becomes a liability in skirmishes and objective fights where you can just walk him down.
edits.after: By 2+ items the gap closes through W and the R teleport, not through E — E hops you backward. Ziggs' only out is a 12s Satchel Charge, and one is not enough in a real skirmish.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are rough — Ziggs' Bouncing Bomb range and damage outclass your early Q Twin Drift, and he'll poke you off CS repeatedly with no way for you to punish since he simply won't be in E range; play passive, take farm through minions, and don't contest bomb trades you can't win.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are rough, but not because of range — Bouncing Bomb is 850 to your 900. It is frequency: every cast shortens Short Fuse, so his bonus-damage auto keeps coming while your Q is on 9 seconds. Farm behind minions and refuse the trade until your kit is whole.

edits.before: The moment you unlock Q and E together around level 3, the matchup flips hard — E Weirding gives you the mobility to actually close his range advantage, and once you're in his face his short-ranged kit and lack of true escape (Satchel Charge aside) mean you win nearly every trade from here through his own Level 6 spike, which does nothing to change the duel.
edits.after: From level 3 the matchup flips — but the closing tool is W, not E: the hop covers 700 and E only slows before hopping you backward. Land the E on his feet so he is slowed inside your pattern, and remember his ultimate at 5000 range is a wave and tower tool, not a duel button, so his own level 6 changes the map and not the lane.

edits.before: Use E Weirding's mobility to close the gap once you have Q and E both up
edits.after: Close with the W hop and save E for the slow, since it hops you backward

notes: 1) MC_REAL_GAMES shows 787 games, so this matchup was audited rather than deferred. 2) The packet's suspect name 'Use Mega Inferno Bomb' is a FALSE POSITIVE — that is Ziggs' real R and wants.foe[3] is correct as written, including the observation that it is a wave and tower tool rather than a duel button. I left it alone. 3) The brief's missingInteractions claims Satchel Charge 'bypasses stacking resistances' via a percentHealth flag. Riot's text says nothing about percent health — it is a knock-away that also displaces Ziggs — so I did not write any resistance-bypass claim. That flag looks like a tooltip-parse misfire and should probably be suppressed for Ziggs. 4) The biggest correction here is not a name: four fields described Aurora's E as a gap-close when Riot's text has it hop her BACKWARD. Since that phrasing ('E Weirding', 'dash-adjacent mobility') looks templated, it is likely wrong on other aurora matchups too and is worth a repo-wide grep. 5) 'Q Twin Drift' appears again and was removed where I edited; still unverifiable from the brief.
